mapper.sql: (SELECT count(*) FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt > #{today})) AS "peopleCount", (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.prj j WHERE j.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND j.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD')) AS "projectCount"
SELECT p.bsn_part_id,p.bsn_part_nm,p.hq_yn,p.use_yn,p.sort_seq, FROM mst.bsn_part p WHERE p.bsn_part_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT part_std_hist_id,aply_bgn_ym,aply_end_ym,ldr_nm,prft_dstrb_rt,bsn_fee_amt, CASE WHEN aply_bgn_ym > #{month} THEN '예정' WHEN aply_end_ym IS NULL OR aply_end_ym >= #{month} THEN '적용 중' ELSE '지난 기준' END AS status FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym,part_std_hist_id
SELECT max(cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'
SELECT bsn_part_id AS id,bsn_part_nm AS name,hq_yn='Y' AS hq FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE use_yn='Y' ORDER BY sort_seq,bsn_part_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_nm=#{value} AND bsn_part_id <> #{id})
mapper.update: UPDATE mst.bsn_part SET bsn_part_nm=#{value},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id}
UPDATE mst.bsn_part SET use_yn=#{value},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id} AND aply_bgn_ym >= #{start} AND aply_bgn_ym > #{month}
mapper.update: UPDATE mst.bsn_part_std_hist SET aply_end_ym=#{previous} WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id} AND aply_bgn_ym < #{start} AND (aply_end_ym IS NULL OR aply_end_ym >= #{start})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_id IN #{id}
